note: Bambu A1 mini, PCTG (PETG settings + 10 C) unless TPU. Counts are for the whole arm (two heads); the test set's own counts are in test_set. Nothing here is handed: both blades are one file, both pilots are one file (the second is the first turned half round).

test_set.what: one grab unit, to try on the bench against the Scout latch cartridge (parts/latch7/kit.json)

bought.check: E: the spline's tip 6.0 out of the case top and the ears 2.5 thick (not in the sheet). Measure both: the paddle's nose and the ear tab follow

bought.spec: o 3 carbon rod (on hand): two 66 long, two 9 long
o 6 x 0.7 wire x 25, two per blade
bought.check: on a scale: 12.5 N at 17.1 long

bought.spec: the latch's spring (o 3.0, 0.3 wire, 30 free) cut to 15 long, two side by side under each pilot (they were one o 6 x 20, which has no way into the pocket)
bought.check: E 0.25 N/mm each cut to 15: about 2 N a pilot at rest, 5 N flush. The pilot must come back up by itself
the M3 x 12 listing's other lengths (M3 x 35 not confirmed on it: any M3 x 35 does). E: it reaches 7 into the servo's shaft; if it bottoms before the paddle is tight, washers under its head

bought.spec: M3 x 8 socket head, into the tab's o 2.5 holes (they cut their thread)
thin cyanoacrylate: rod ends, pilot pins, pads

steps: Trial fit dry first: the servo must slide in from the open side with its spline in the slot, and the paddle's o 5.8 bore must press onto the spline by the screw (it cuts its own teeth; E).
1 Servo in from the open side; two M3 x 8 through its inner ear into the tab, driver through the two holes in the end bar. The outer ear stays free.
2 Paddle: lower it between the walls, slide it onto the spline, M3 x 35 through it from the hub end (driver through the o 6.4 hole). Servo at grip: paddle along the bay.
3 Each pilot: two cut springs into the pocket, pilot on them, press 1 mm, push the o 3 x 9 pin in from the blade bay. It must sink 5 and come back.
4 Each blade down into its bay with its two springs against the wall; then both o 3 x 66 rods through wall, springs and blades. CA at the rod ends when it works.
5 Pads: the 2.4 ones into their seats, dry for now.

Try: turn the paddle a quarter turn by hand or with the servo: the blades open to 22.6 between faces (grip 12.4). Set the unit under the Scout cartridge (pilots into the recess corners), let the blades close on the tabs: both bolts must draw in and the cartridge lift out of its receiver with the unit; open: it must stay behind latched.

Report: does the paddle hold on the spline, do the blades reach the tabs' stop (bolts fully in), does the cartridge sit on all four Scout pads with the blades closed (if not, which pad and by how much: that picks the pad thickness).

steps.step: 1 servo in from the open side (+x), its spline through the slot in the wall; two M3 x 8 through the inner ear from the far end (driver through the end bar's two holes)
2 paddle down between the walls 4.5 short of the spline, slid onto it, one M3 x 35 through it from the hub end (driver through the o 6.4 hole)
3 each pilot: two o 3 springs into its pocket, the pilot down on them, pressed 1 mm, its o 3 x 9 pin pushed in from the blade bay
4 each blade down into its bay at the grip position (paddle turned along the bay), its two springs between it and the wall
5 the two o 3 x 66 rods in from one side through wall, springs and both blades; a drop of CA at each end
6 the eight pads into their seats (2.4 first), CA

order.step: 1 grab-unit test set, one head (try it on the Scout cartridge)
2 pad set-up spares, once (pick per pad at set-up)
3 one head's slide: carriage, lift, rail, three wheels, two ties (proves the reach and the push on the bench before the hub is printed)
4 stub side and hub (the longest print)
5 the second head: everything of 1 and 3 again
6 the ring: saddles and links, with the bays

open.state: E until the rail is here
open.what: the carriage's four M3 inserts are 25 apart from 12.5 in from the rail's end (a 100 rail with four holes can only be 12.5 / 25 / 25 / 25 / 12.5 if it is cut evenly). Measure the first hole from each end and the pitch before printing the carriage
open.if_off: parts/box_arm8_lib.py MGN first / pitch, and the carriage reruns (its rail seat and loads follow)

open.state: E 5.8 N/mm from wire and coil count
open.what: on a kitchen scale: 18 N at 11.9 long (the preload), about 32 N at 9.4
open.if_off: the push limit (118 N) and the float's preload follow the rate: parts/box_arm8_lib.py K_FLOAT, P_FLOAT; no printed part changes unless the limit leaves 97..125 N

open.state: E: the ties' holes are o 5.6
open.what: measure the insert's body before printing the ties (o 5.6 suits a 6.0 knurl, 5.0 long)
open.if_off: parts/box_arm8_lib.py tie(): the hole; the ties are drawn pieces, no run

assembly: Stub side: press the two 6010-2RS into the hub's sleeve from the stub end, slide the hub on the stub, screw the post on; axle stepper and 16T pulley on the stub's ear, belt round the hub's ring, detent arm with its 623ZZ on its pivot.
Each V rail on the hub's plate: two M5 x 10 into the heat-set M5 inserts.

Each carriage: four M3 inserts in the spine, the MGN12 rail on it with four M3 x 12 (block on the rail, stoppers off only at the bench); three V wheels, two 625ZZ in each, on M5 x 20 axles, the third on its eccentric bush; roll it onto the V rail and set the bush until it runs without play. The tab on the spine's side is the pick-up stop: the lift's nut lug meets it as the block's top reaches the rail's end.

Each screw drive: stepper on its face plate (four M3), coupler, inner F8-16M, screw through the thrust wall, outer F8-16M, lock ring; the nut on the screw with its flange's two sides filed to the body.

Each lift: bond the three o 6 x 115 carbon rods in the yoke's sockets (resin through each port until it shows at the mouth), slide the two ties on and bond them at their stations (float bolt centres 45 hub side and 20 far side of the tab line); four M4 inserts in each pair of ties.
Yoke on the MGN block with four M3 x 12; the nut into its lug (flange in the slot); the return spring from the carriage to the rail's channel.

Each grab unit (the steps and their sweeps: parts/box_arm8/kit.json test_set): servo in from the open side, two M3 x 8 through its inner ear; paddle onto the spline, M3 x 35 from the hub end; each pilot on two cut o 3 springs, its o 3 x 9 pin in from the blade bay; blades and their four springs, the two o 3 x 66 rods through; an SS49E in each hall post; the eight TPU pads into their seats.
Grab unit on the ties: four M4 shoulder bolts down through the base with a PTFE and a steel washer under each head, a float spring round each bolt between tie and base.
Ring: each bay's receiver on its saddle by the receiver's own mount bolts, the 20 link bars between neighbouring ears.

Set up: with a cartridge gripped, each pad must touch the pack's bottom: swap a pad for the next thickness where it does not, then glue; park by the screw's position; check both hall readings with the bolts in and out.
